title: PAH-OMC-020 static coupling versus root-wise energy intertwining
question: Does the R-525 maximal-prefix conditional-expectation candidate contain enough dynamic root and conductance data to establish the N2b form liminf, or is a source-authorized energy-intertwining datum still missing?
method: Freeze the immutable PAH-001 functional, the PAH-OMC-020 j-before-anchored-n order, the R-510/R-511 state/form chain, the R-512 minimal target, the R-525 candidate and the R-528 fixed owner snapshot.
State the exact one-root directed-half implication using a root difference factor kappa and conductance weights, then sum only under a uniform residual or root-wise contraction hypothesis.

Reconstruct an abstract two-state reversible oracle with identical stationary marginals and identity static coupling, but a doubled target rate, to test whether L2 contraction alone controls Dirichlet energy.
Run primary, non-importing independent, hostile and Lean checks and keep the oracle explicitly outside the PAH model.
finding: The weighted one-root implication is exact under the required root-wise dynamic intertwining and conductance inequality. R-525 supplies only static L2 contraction/local N1 recovery and R-528 has no source-authorized packet. The abstract oracle has equal L2 norms but target energy 1 versus source energy 1/2, so static coupling cannot be promoted to form compatibility.
decision_reason: This closes a reusable conditional evidence contract and replaces the vague phrase 'energy compatibility' with a concrete root-indexed datum and residual test. It does not repeat owner absence as a theorem, and it does not assert a PAH counterexample.
boundary: All PAH-001 functions, rates, states, carrier, regulator order and external Markov time remain unchanged. The conditional implication and the two-state oracle are finite algebra only; N2b arbitrary-sequence liminf/recovery, N2c/N4, N2d and ordered semigroup convergence remain open.
next_action: Request or locate one source-authorized packet giving root multiplicity, conductance weights, dynamic difference intertwining or a uniformly vanishing form defect, including the terminal-square correspondence, for the exact R-525 U_n.
revisit_condition: Reopen after such a packet is hash-pinned or after a PAH-specific exact form contradiction is found; do not repeat the abstract static-coupling oracle.
non_claims: No source-authorized U_n, N2b liminf/recovery, N2c/N4 boundary escape, N2d minimal-form identification or PAH-OMC-020 semigroup convergence.
The two-state witness is not a PAH counterexample and does not prove a universal impossibility theorem.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, Yang-Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion.
verification_summary: Primary 37/37, independent 28/28, hostile 19/19, integrated 30/30 and Lean 4.32.1 six declarations pass.
